title: Estimated tax and surtaxes — the Parks
instructions: Sam and Jo Park file jointly. Use the exhibits to compute their 2025 safe-harbor payment and surtaxes.

exhibits.title: 2025 projections
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Sam's wages | 210,000 |
| Jo's wages | 90,000 |
| Qualified dividends | 25,000 |
| Long-term capital gain | 15,000 |
| Taxable interest | 5,000 |
| Distribution from Jo's traditional IRA | 10,000 |
| Expected total 2025 tax (including surtaxes) | 74,000 |
| Federal income tax withheld | 50,000 |

There are no adjustments to income; MAGI equals AGI.

rows.label: Required annual payment to avoid the underpayment penalty
Net investment income tax
rows.explanation: NII = 25,000 + 15,000 + 5,000 = 45,000 (the IRA distribution isn't NII). MAGI excess = 105,000. 3.8% × lesser (45,000) = **1,710**.

rows.label: Additional Medicare tax on the return (total)
Additional Medicare tax already withheld by Sam's employer
rows.explanation: Employers withhold 0.9% on wages over $200,000: 0.9% × 10,000 = **90**; the other 360 is paid with the return.

parts.prompt: Classify each item for the NIIT.

rows.label: Rent from a rental in which the Parks don't materially participate
Sam's wages
rows.explanation: Wages are subject to the additional Medicare tax instead.
